user.title: Music Assistant Amp Zone Player
user.description: Choose the decoder (real streamer) and the amp zone media players for Music Assistant (Composer-style sessions).

data.digital_sound_mode: Sound mode when digital zone joins (optional)
data.name_prefix: Name prefix for facade players (optional — leave blank)
data.name: Hub name (optional — blank becomes Amp zones; does not prefix players)

data_description.playback: Optional Music Assistant House SyncGroup (or similar). Play/pause goes there so Sonys stay in sync; amp zones only open the analog feed from the WiiM.
data_description.digital_zones: MA / AirPlay / Cast players (e.g. Basement STR-AZ1000ES). They appear in the same group list as amp facades; joining syncs them to the WiiM in the background.
data_description.digital_sound_mode: Exact sound_mode string if the player exposes select_sound_mode (e.g. Multi Stereo). Leave blank if unavailable.
data_description.name: Shown only as the integration entry / device label. Player names stay short (e.g. Bar Speakers).
data_description.zones: Control4 Audio speaker zones, or zones from Monoprice, Russound, Yamaha, Onkyo, Denon, etc.

source.title: Amp input when turning on
source.description:
{hint}

The list is built from each zone’s **source_list** (the same names you see in the zone more-info Source dropdown). Pick one, leave as None, or type the exact plain-text label if it is missing.

data_description.source: Plain text matching the zone source list (e.g. WiiM Pro). Not a media_player entity ID.

error.entity_not_found: One or more entities were not found
error.no_zones: Select at least one amp zone or digital receiver
error.decoder_in_zones: Decoder cannot also be listed as a zone
error.bad_zone: Pick amp/matrix zone media players only (e.g. Control4 Audio speaker zones — not the bare Amp/Switch player)
error.bad_decoder: Pick a real streamer (WiiM, Cast, DLNA, Music Assistant player, etc.) — not an amp zone
error.bad_digital_zone: Digital zones must be streamer/receiver players (e.g. MA Sony), not amp matrix zones
error.digital_in_amp_zones: A player cannot be both an amp zone and a digital zone
error.playback_in_zones: Queue player cannot also be listed as an amp or digital zone

confirm.title: Clear invalid amp source
confirm.description:
The entry **{title}** selects amp source `{source}`, but that name is not in any configured zone’s `source_list`.

Clear the source? Zones will keep their current input when turned on (you can set a new source later in Configure).
